full_judgment:
Mr. Mohammad Gholam Rabbani, J.: This matter has arisen out of a small cause court suit for ejectment of monthly tenants instituted by the appellants before us against the tenant-respondents. The suit was decreed by the judgment and decree dated 8.11.1995 on the finding that the tenant-defendants were habitual defaulters in the payment of rents during the period from March, 1986 to August, 1986 vide rent receipt exhibit-B and during the period from January, 1981 to December, 1981 vide rent receipt exhibit-B(1). 

 8. In the result the appeal is allowed without any order as to costs. Judgment and order dated 13.8.1998 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 1200 of 1996 are set aside and the judgment and decree dated 8.11.1995 passed by the S.C.C. Judge, Sadar, Sylhet, in S.C.0 Suit No. 3 of 1992 are restored.
